# DEP-03 §Grounded arms (DEP-18 grounded-arms-v7), shared with deposits-rust
# (deposits-node/tests/grounded_arms_vector.rs).  Generated from the signet soak's own proofs.
#
# class <name>      the grounds of one DisputeEnter, from the DisputeEnter alone:
#   reason <reason>
#   anchor <anchor_block_height | ->
#   hash <fraud_proof_hash hex | ->
#   proof <fraud_proof: the DEP-06 JSON form of a broadcast, on one line | ->
#   enter <signed block_height> expiry <quorum_expiry at its last_valid_sequence | ->
#   operator <the operator of the update at its last_valid_sequence, hex | ->
#   expect expiry | ungrounded | verify     (verify: the proof must then verify as a received proof)
#   end
#
# cut <name>        the eligibility cut's grounds step over armers' verdicts:
#   ruleset <name>
#   armer <key> grounded|ungrounded|unknown
#   expect <keys in order> | expect none | expect error
#   end
#
# shape <name>      the confiscation's shape over DisputeEnters' reasons and verdicts:
#   ruleset <name>
#   enter <reason> grounded|ungrounded|unknown
#   expect respectful | punitive | error
#   end
#
# A quorum_expired dispute entered past the quorum_expiry: an expiry ground.
class expiry-past
reason quorum_expired
anchor -
hash -
proof -
enter 1200 expiry 1100
operator -
expect expiry
end
# Entered at the quorum_expiry itself, not past it: no ground.
class expiry-at
reason quorum_expired
anchor -
hash -
proof -
enter 1100 expiry 1100
operator -
expect ungrounded
end
# No quorum_expiry in force at its fork point: no expiry ground.
class expiry-unknown
reason quorum_expired
anchor -
hash -
proof -
enter 1200 expiry -
operator -
expect ungrounded
end
# A generic reason, no proof cited, entered past the expiry: a quorum_expired dispute (DEP-05).
class generic-past-expiry
reason auto_dispute
anchor -
hash -
proof -
enter 1200 expiry 1100
operator -
expect expiry
end
# A generic reason with an expiry anchor: a quorum_expired dispute.
class generic-anchor
reason fraud
anchor 1150
hash -
proof -
enter 1200 expiry 1100
operator -
expect expiry
end

anchor -

proof {"proof":{"proof_type":"NonConformingUpdate","accused":"03abec63a919379b826b83a3b7be65931a46e31d7cf2614e45e67d251d0923e02b","ledger_id":"5b347b810b4d3504d29be7f9e817ff55e18d7464b1c6dc235c44b136b314ed72","evidence":{"NonConformingUpdate":{"fault_sequence":103515,"fault_update_hex":""}}},"causal_chain":[]}
enter 1200 expiry 1100
operator 03abec63a919379b826b83a3b7be65931a46e31d7cf2614e45e67d251d0923e02b
expect verify
end

# Under grounded-arms-v7 the armer without grounds is disregarded.
cut v7-excludes
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
armer b grounded
armer c grounded
armer d ungrounded
expect b c
end
# Under balance-anchor-v6 grounds are not examined.
cut v6-includes
ruleset balance-anchor-v6
armer b grounded
armer c grounded
armer d ungrounded
expect b c d
end
# A ground not judged yet stops the cut: no cut, no proposal, no signature, no verdict.
cut v7-unknown
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
armer b grounded
armer d unknown
expect error
end
# Under an earlier ruleset nothing is judged, so nothing is unknown.
cut v6-unknown
ruleset balance-anchor-v6
armer b grounded
armer d unknown
expect b d
end
# No armer has grounds: nobody is in the lottery.
cut v7-none
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
armer d ungrounded
expect none
end
# Soak, 2026-11-02, F: cld1's arm on its fork whose proof every verifier rejected no longer joins the lottery.
cut f-case-v7
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
armer cld1 ungrounded
armer cld4 grounded
armer cld5 grounded
armer cld6 grounded
expect cld4 cld5 cld6
end
# The same under balance-anchor-v6: cld1 was a participant, as on the soak.
cut f-case-v6
ruleset balance-anchor-v6
armer cld1 ungrounded
armer cld4 grounded
armer cld5 grounded
armer cld6 grounded
expect cld1 cld4 cld5 cld6
end
# An accusation without grounds cannot turn a respectful confiscation punitive.
shape v7-ungrounded-punitive-ignored
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
enter quorum_expired grounded
enter quorum_expired grounded
enter non_conforming_update ungrounded
expect respectful
end
# Under balance-anchor-v6 every DisputeEnter counts.
shape v6-every-enter
ruleset balance-anchor-v6
enter quorum_expired grounded
enter quorum_expired grounded
enter non_conforming_update ungrounded
expect punitive
end
# A grounded punitive DisputeEnter makes it punitive.
shape v7-grounded-punitive
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
enter quorum_expired grounded
enter equivocation grounded
expect punitive
end
# A ground not judged yet: no shape.
shape v7-unknown
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
enter quorum_expired grounded
enter equivocation unknown
expect error
end
# No DisputeEnter counts: not respectful.
shape v7-none-grounded
ruleset grounded-arms-v7
enter equivocation ungrounded
expect punitive
end
